program:
app "Birthdays" gift plum
table bday name text, day date
remind "Birthday today" at bday.day
each bday sort day as b
  row card gap 1 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow
      b.name bold
      b.day faint

form bday, "Add birthday"

label: ctrl-en-r3
request: a habit app with streaks and a chart
program:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0 or done = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 36 radius 6 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 70 radius 6 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

program:
app "To do" list slate
table task title text, due date?, done bool, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal
count(task where done = no) "open" head
each task where done = no sort priority desc as t

    toggle t.done

form task
